body.name: Phi_ell_R
body.def: \(\Phi_{\ell,R}\) is the polynomial map \(C_r=\kappa^{S}_{0,r}(1,\gamma,\beta\gamma)^{\otimes r}+\sum_{i\in I_{\ell}}\kappa^{S}_{i,r}(1,u_i,v_i)^{\otimes r}+\kappa^{S}_{t,r}(0,1,\beta)^{\otimes r}+\kappa^{S}_{y,r}(0,0,1)^{\otimes r}\) for \(2\le r\le R\), restricted to \(\Theta_{\ell,R}\).
